speaker: Officer
text: This is going to be your probationary period which We will make us determine whether you deserve this job or not.

speaker: Officer
text: Your job is very easy; you just have to check on people suspected of smuggling contraband.

speaker: Officer
text: You should check each person`s passport, ID, the smell of the bag, and its contents. Be aware if the bag contains a lot of food.

speaker: Officer
text: After verifying all the suspects and speaking with them, you should report the person carrying the prohibited items.

speaker: Officer
text: If we discover that you reported an innocent person, you will be dismissed from this job. otherwise, you`ll continue with us.
